    • add

      public boolean add(N element)
      Adds an element to the set if it was not already a member.

      The element added must be one of the objects from the set of objects this set may contain, otherwise an exception will be thrown.

      Specified by:
      add in class BigSet<N extends edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Numbered>
      Parameters:
      element - the element
      Returns:
      true if the element was not a member and the set is now larger because the element was added, false if the element was already a member
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the object is not one of the objects that can potentially be member of this set
